entities.summary: Isabelle Haverlag is a Dutch tennis player who specializes in doubles. She has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 96, by the WTA, achieved on 14 April 2025. She has won 13 doubles titles on the ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. Isabelle Haverlag was a athletes & competitors from Bussum (b. 2001-03-04, Bussum). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
